title: Nitrogen regulation in polyester-based carbons and adsorption of gaseous benzene and ethyl acetate
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,37359-37369
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07004F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Gang Wang, Pingping Tan, Ziyan Kong, Jianfang Ao, Ran Wang, Zhongshen Zhang, Zhengping Hao
The influences of nitrogen doping using four organic compounds on polyester-based carbons are investigated. Pyridine shows the maximum improvement in the adsorption of VOCs with different polarities under both dry and wet conditions.
